reviewer: AI-assisted visual triage (ChatGPT); independent human sign-off pending
reviewMethod: Qualitative side-by-side visual inspection of the pinned source photographs and SHA-256-linked fixed-camera render PNGs. This is not a calibrated photogrammetry, measured-elevation, or pixel-similarity assessment.

comparisons.notes: In the pinned straight-on front photograph, the two-storey facade has substantially more vertical presence; the central dome/pavilion and broad ceremonial stair are dominant, with a clear rhythm of arched openings and articulated end pavilions. In the generated front render, the facade reads as a long, low strip; the central dome/pavilion and stair read noticeably undersized relative to the facade, and the repeated facade detail is much less articulated. This is a qualitative shape/detail mismatch; the image headings and lens were not supplied and no dimensions were measured from pixels.
comparisons.correctionRequest: Reconcile the provisional 125.4 m overall extent with the 55.8 m working Rangmahal frontage before changing geometry; inspect whether Andarmahal is being presented as a continuous south-front wall instead of a set-back adjoining mass. Recalibrate the front-elevation width/height relationship, central pavilion and dome, main stair width/projection, opening rhythm and end pavilions against a rectified same-facade image. Every changed parameter must retain a confidence tag and source note; do not relabel estimates as verified.

comparisons.notes: The southeast-oblique source photograph shows a recognizable long facade meeting a more strongly articulated end pavilion, substantial arches/columns, stair and projecting/arched lower-level elements. The turntable-315 render shows a much simpler block composition with broad, nearly black flat-looking roof surfaces and markedly less facade articulation; the side mass/corner silhouette does not convincingly reproduce the source. This comparison remains pose-estimated because the source lists a camera location but not a calibrated heading or lens, so the exact view angle is not proven.
comparisons.correctionRequest: First verify surface normals, material/light response and roof geometry so the roof is not rendered as a near-black unfeatured plane. Refine the east/end pavilion, visible arch/column rhythm, projecting lower-level arches/stairs and the mass intersection from sources that show those areas. Calibrate camera heading if additional metadata can be recovered; keep unobserved surfaces marked unknown rather than inventing them.

humanAcceptance.note: These findings are AI-assisted visual triage and are not independent architect/heritage-specialist sign-off. Model fidelity and publication remain blocked until a human reviewer confirms the findings, geometry corrections are rendered again, and the revised side-by-side review is recorded.

limitations: Source camera heading/lens metadata is incomplete; view pairing is estimated.
No pixel similarity score, survey measurements, certified scale, or georeference residual is inferred.
Review outcomes describe visible disagreement, not proof of every hidden facade detail.
